D-338 fixed the landing site of G21LJ-V19-SF1 and G21LJ-V19-SF2 at leftover-join.v20 of G21, and the subject's own basedOn.predecessorV20.reviews records that v20 then passed dual ACCEPT 0/0 - the landings held. It is also the exact rewrite the dispatch forbids ('Do not rewrite basedOn.predecessorV19.role Findings land at leftover-join.v20 of G21') and the exact named attack ('basedOn.predecessorV19.role Findings land rewritten off leftover-join.v20 of G21').

mustFixFindings.claim: leftoverDesignOpenStanding: 'leftover-design of remaining CC-5 injections remains: prefix exactly at the operative bound including its postHandshake half; the postHandshake half of far-over; truncated bodies; ...' and obligations[3].reason: 'The far-over family is not exhausted: the postHandshake half remains unauthored and the preHandshake half is witnessed by one non-unique far-over integer.'
mustFixFindings.measurement: $.leftoverDesignOpenStanding is byte-identical to leftover-join.v20 of G21's field of the same name. $.obligations[3].reason names every prior authoring act in the chain - D-241, D-243, D-245, D-247, D-301, D-302, D-335, D-337 - and stops there; the string 'D-348' occurs zero times in it, and zero times anywhere in $.obligations. Meanwhile $.purpose, $.authorityClaim and $.registerRowNote each assert 'leftover-design of the D-348 prefix-far-over-posthandshake injection is remasured stale as an authoring claim', and $.obligations[3].remainingNotAuthored.remainingCc5Injections[1] was advanced from v20's 'CC-5 prefix far over the operative bound (postHandshake half remains; preHandshake half witnessed by one non-unique far-over integer)' to 'CC-5 prefix far over the operative bound (both halves witnessed by one non-unique far-over integer; family not exhausted)'. Live COORD D-348 confirms the authoring act: 'Record g21-fixture-corpus.v21 as G21 leftover-design CC-5 prefix-far-over-posthandshake injection after D-347.'
mustFixFindings.why: The postHandshake half of far-over is the single class this remasurement exists to measure, and the artifact says two opposite things about it inside its own bytes. Three prose fields say its leftover-design is stale because D-348 authored it; one array element says both halves are now witnessed; and two measurement fields - the standing enumeration of what leftover-design remains, and the reason attached to the very obligation being measured - still say it remains unauthored and remains leftover-design. A reader taking leftoverDesignOpenStanding at face value would conclude the D-348 authoring never happened; a reader taking purpose at face value would conclude it did. Both readings cannot be recorded. This is not an incomplete recital: it is a live false claim sitting in the field whose stated job is to carry the standing measurement, and it is false in the direction that under-reports authored work. D-348 explicitly deferred this measurement - 'Whether leftover-design of this injection is stale as an authoring claim after this recording is for a later leftover-join remasurement succeeding leftover-join.v20 of G21 to measure; this entry does not measure it' - so the subject is the artifact charged with making exactly this measurement, and in its measurement layer it did not make it.
mustFixFindings.scopeNote: This is distinct from a naming or provenance gap. basedOn.fixtureCorpusV21 pins the corpus correctly and recordedInputs carries its digest; the defect is that the measurement fields were never advanced to consume it.
mustFixFindings.remedy: Advance leftoverDesignOpenStanding to recite leftover-design of the D-348 prefix-far-over-posthandshake injection as stale as an authoring claim and to drop 'the postHandshake half of far-over' from the remaining-CC-5 enumeration, and advance obligations[3].reason to name g21-fixture-corpus.v21 (D-348) in the authoring chain and to stop asserting the postHandshake half remains unauthored. Keep 'prefix exactly at the operative bound' in both, and keep per-D-002-platform copies of the D-348 bytes as remaining leftover-design.

mustFixFindings.claim: remeasurementClause: 'Frozen g21 leftover-join.v17 remains the current recorded G21 leftover remasurement (D-336) until a recordable successor is adopted.' predecessorV14.role and predecessorV13.role: 'Current recorded G21 leftover remasurement is g21 leftover-join.v17 (D-336) until a recordable successor is adopted.' predecessorV17.role: 'g21 leftover-join.v17 remains current until a recordable successor is adopted.'

A recordable successor has since been adopted: live COORD D-338 is ADOPTED 2026-08-31 and records g21-fixture-corpus... g21-leftover-join.v20.json 213d11c8... as the G21 leftover remasurement, and within that same D-338 block states 'Frozen g21 leftover-join.v17 stays frozen; do not record it as current after' that adoption. The dispatch states the same standing, and the subject's own $.purpose, $.authorityClaim and $.registerRowNote all say 'Frozen leftover-join.v20 of G21 remains the current recorded remasurement (D-338) until a recordable successor is adopted.'
mustFixFindings.why: The condition these four fields attach to - 'until a recordable successor is adopted' - has already fired, so the claims are not merely stale, they are false against the very clause they carry. The artifact therefore names two different current recorded G21 leftover remasurements: v17 in four places and v20 in three. remeasurementClause is the worst site, because it is the field a recorder consults to decide whether the artifact may be recorded at all, and it also lists the unmoved-guard set as 'file 08, g21 leftover-join.v17, occupancy v4, g21-fixture-corpus.v19, doctor-actor leftover-join.v12, and g21 leftover-join.v21' - guarding v17 while omitting leftover-join.v20 of G21, the actual frozen recorded predecessor this successor must not displace. A recorder following remeasurementClause would check the wrong artifact for movement and would carry forward v17 as current, demoting a dual-ACCEPT recording adopted at D-338.
mustFixFindings.note: predecessorV17.role does append 'Do not record g21 leftover-join.v17 as current after this successor is recorded', and doesNot[55] repeats it. That mitigation does not cure the finding: those clauses defer to a future recording, whereas 'remains current' and 'Current recorded G21 leftover remasurement is g21 leftover-join.v17 (D-336)' are assertions about the present, and the present already has v20 recorded.
mustFixFindings.remedy: Advance all four to name leftover-join.v20 of G21 (D-338) as the current recorded G21 leftover remasurement, mark v17 historical after D-338, and replace g21 leftover-join.v17 with g21 leftover-join.v20 in remeasurementClause's unmoved-guard set.
